questionText: In pediatric clinical assessment, Kwashiorkor is clinically distinguished from Marasmus by the prominent presence of:

Oedema (fluid accumulation in legs and face) and enlarged fatty liver with adequate calorie intake but acute protein deficiency

By replacing physical grain mandis with government-mandated centralized digital auctions and subsidized transport logistics
By providing direct financial subsidies and low-interest bank credit lines to smallholder farmers for purchasing heavy farm machinery
By offering guaranteed export quotas to international agricultural trade boards at fixed price contracts prior to harvesting
